en.headline: Housing Bureau reminds Wang Fuk owners of 15 October deadline
en.dek: Owners in blocks A to H who accepted the buyout must sign sale agreements by 15 October, with discretion for special cases.
body: The Housing Bureau reminded owners of Wang Fuk Court blocks A to H in Tai Po that anyone who returned a completed and signed acceptance letter by 31 August must sign an agreement to sell their flat on or before 15 October, whatever option they chose.

The bureau said owners who cannot sign in time because of special circumstances, such as unresolved title or a longer probate process, will be considered case by case. It said the government would follow a principle of balancing compassion, reason and the law, with compassion first, and would notify the owners concerned before the deadline.

A dedicated sales scheme for Wang Fuk owners began flat selection on 29 September. Applicants who have signed the sale agreement, and have therefore confirmed in law that they are selling their interest to the government, are invited to choose a flat. Invitation letters are being issued in batches according to a computer ballot, and the bureau expects selection to finish by the end of November.

Owners who have not yet signed because of special circumstances, but who complete the agreement before the selection period ends, will still be invited to choose. If title has not yet passed to the government, the bureau will reserve a new flat at the selection stage only, and the Housing Authority or Housing Society will sign the purchase agreement after the transfer.
An explanation team coordinated by the bureau is contacting owners who have not yet signed, the bureau said.

zh.headline: 房屋局提醒宏福苑業主本月15日前簽協議
zh.dek: A至H座已交回接受收購信件的業主，須於10月15日或之前簽出售單位協議，特殊情況可獲酌情。
body: 房屋局提醒大埔宏福苑A至H座業主，若已於8月31日或之前交回填妥並簽署的「接受收購建議信件」，不論選擇哪一個選項，均須於10月15日限期屆滿當日或之前，完成簽署出售單位的《買賣協議》。
房屋局表示，若業主因特殊情況未能及時簽署，例如未能釐清業權，或需要較長時間處理遺產承辦，政府會按個別情況酌情考慮，並稱會本著情、理、法兼備、以情為先的原則處理，限期前通知相關業主。
為宏福苑業主而設的「特設銷售計劃」已於9月29日展開選樓。完成簽署出售協議、在法律上確認向政府出售業權的申請者會獲邀選樓。房屋局已按電腦抽籤次序分批發邀請信，預計11月底完成選樓。
因特殊情況尚未簽署、但在選樓期結束前完成簽署的業主，仍會獲邀選樓。若業權尚未轉予政府，房屋局只會在選樓階段先預留一個新單位，待業權完成轉讓後，房委會或房協才與業主簽購買新單位的協議。
房屋局統籌的「解說專隊」正聯絡尚未簽署出售協議的業主。
